primary_source.name: NASA GSFC Planetary Geodesy Data Archive

common_metadata.projection: South-polar stereographic X/Y coordinates in metres
common_metadata.caveat: 5 m pixel spacing is not equivalent to independent 5 m measurement spacing; use LDEC and uncertainty layers.

core_products.purpose: Base elevation surface for terrain mesh, elevation queries, derived slope and horizon calculations.
Measurement-support layer; helps identify sparse sampling and interpolation.
NASA-supplied slope product for terrain screening and validation of independently calculated slope.
Vertical uncertainty layer for traceable terrain and horizon analysis.
Slope uncertainty for terrain suitability confidence.

optional_products.purpose: Adjusted/cleaned LOLA point observations; useful for inspecting actual measurement support; potentially large.
DEM error-realisation ensemble for uncertainty propagation; large optional download.
GIS region-of-interest shapefiles for study-region masks and reproducible summaries.

complementary_sources.name: PGDA Shape-from-Shading DEMs
complementary_sources.purpose: Complementary enhanced topography using LOLA control and LROC NAC images; confirm exact regional overlap and frame before use.

complementary_sources.name: LROC NAC calibrated imagery
complementary_sources.purpose: Visual context and potential small-feature inspection; exact image product IDs and geometry must be recorded.

complementary_sources.name: LROC QuickMap
complementary_sources.purpose: Terrain discovery and visual inspection only; map tiles/screenshots are not numeric DEM inputs.

complementary_sources.name: NASA Moon Trek
complementary_sources.purpose: 3D map context and layer discovery; use actual documented source products for analysis.
